Pretty good visual effects for the time.

In its defense, Pathecolor was NOT, as is sarcastically described here, color tinted black and white film. It was a major Eastmancolor-based process used in many films over the decades and often looked stunning. The color tinting in this film is simply because the original Russian movie was black and white and American distributors wanted a color release. Thus the Russian scenes were tinted, and the new footage was in color. The full-color sequences have just faded over time, as most Eastmancolor has.

I am glad I watched it. Lots of strange, bizarre science and movie making. Low budget for sure. No Oscar nominations here. But if your expectations are not too high, it is a charming unbelievable romp through the early years of what space travel was thought to include.

rv: The jewish ideals as a fashion statement

When I first started watching this film and came across it's bombastic beginning dedicating this film to teens with bombastic decency (note the underlining) I thought for sure it was going to be this social guidance melodrama. What I DIDN'T know was that it was going to be of all things, anti-semitism! A teenage girl gets a bracelet for her birthday by her otherwise bothersome (but great) younger sister. She goes back to the jeweler with her friends when she finds out there is a second part to it. That second part is a star of David pendant! Her friends, and soon, pretty much the whole town…

"The war is over. The Nazis are finished.This kind of thing [anti-Semitism] doesn't happen any more," says Norma's awkward dad, telegraphing what's to come in the rest of the film. It does happen, of course. Norma reads a copy of "The Diary of Anne Frank" and decides to show visible support of solidarity with Jews, defiantly wearing a bracelet with the Star of David. Her friends are too uncomfortable with it. She becomes an outcast. The town's bigots ooze out from hiding and now show their true side. "Go along with the crowd," says her dad. Would he say that if they were talking about sex? It…
It still happens even in the 21st century...
It's so difficult for an old guy like me to see people with their bigoted feelings display them even now. I wish it was all over.
